title: Pho Tak Marathon 2026 (6th Edition) Review: Racing on the Mekong Border
seo_title: Pho Tak Marathon 2026 Review | Nong Khai, Thailand
meta_description: Pho Tak Marathon 2026 review: December 13, the 6th edition in Nong Khai on the Mekong -- Thailand's main crossing point into Laos.
dek: Set for 13 December 2026, the 6th edition of the Pho Tak Marathon runs in Nong Khai, the Thai city on the Mekong River directly across from Vientiane, Laos, connected by the first bridge ever built across the river's lower reaches.
verdict: The Pho Tak Marathon's 6th edition carries genuine multi-year continuity in a genuinely distinctive border location: Nong Khai sits on the Mekong River, home to Thailand's main port of entry to Vientiane, Laos, via the Thai-Lao Friendship Bridge -- the first bridge ever built across the lower Mekong, opened in 1994. Four distances (5K to full marathon) with genuinely budget pricing (350-1,000 THB) make this accessible. Note that the registration deadline listed (5 August 2026) has already passed as of this writing, despite the entity data still marking status as open -- worth confirming directly with organisers whether late registration is possible.

sections.heading: Thailand's Gateway to Laos
paragraphs: Nong Khai is a city in northeast Thailand, capital of Nong Khai province, lying on the Mekong River near the Thai-Lao Friendship Bridge -- the first bridge ever built across the lower reaches of the Mekong, opened in 1994. [2] It's Thailand's main port of entry for traffic to and from Vientiane, the capital of Laos, directly across the river. Nong Khai province contains the longest stretch of the Mekong within Thailand, at 320km.
